14 Days With You [DEMO]

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price
"After moving back to Corland Bay, things have started to become more... unsettling. Your laundry always seems to go missing, creepy footsteps echo down your hallway at night, and to make matters worse, your neighbour swears she saw someone sneak out of your apartment while you were away. But hey… at least the pink-haired stranger you met at work is there to keep you safe."
14 Days With You is an upcoming romantic horror visual novel centred around Ren, a mysterious individual who seems more than obsessed with you — and is willing to do anything he can to have you.

▋GAME FEATURES

  • Customisable MC (name, pronouns, and certain appearance aspects)
  • One yandere love interest named Ren/[REDACTED]
  • Dynamic choices that influence the outcome of the narrative
  • Full-length "Days" with unique scenes and CG art
  • Multiple endings per Day, based on your decisions
  • A gallery and achievement screen for bonus/unlockable content
THIS PROJECT IS INCOMPLETE AND STILL IN DEVELOPMENT!

▋CONTENT WARNINGS

14 Days With You involves mild coarse language, minor jumpscares, depictions of the "yandere" trope, and uncomfortable themes such as physical assault, violence, gore, and death. It also involves eye-straining text, screen shakes, and the potential to cause seizures for those with photosensitive epilepsy. It's intended for those who are 18 and over. MDNI.
VIEW THE FULL LIST OF CONTENT WARNINGS HERE!
